title.narrative: Empoderamiento social para la transición climática

description.narrative: Faced with the trend of deepening extractivism and greater violation of rights with the new government management, the project will work to strengthen civil society, indigenous peoples, women and young people for their active participation in public and political advocacy (water, forests, agroecology, rights of indigenous peoples) at the national and international level, for an agile climate transition, with a focus on justice, social equity, gender and care. Likewise, in the strengthening of the exercise of economic, social, cultural and environmental rights of indigenous and original peasant territories and organizations (highlands and lowlands), as well as the elaboration/implementation of their own norms, procedures and agendas of resistance, within the framework of their self-determination as peoples. At the same time, work will be carried out to make visible and raise awareness of the impacts of the climate crisis and the alternatives that are being built from the territories as responses and proposals to the climate crisis and extractivism. This work aims to give continuity to previous processes, but also to scale up proposals and responses to the climate crisis.
